name: Hollow Days -The Four Days of Sakura-
source:
Story describes four days of everyday life. During daytime it's Shirou's viewpoint while at night Sakura becomes protagonist.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事描写了日常生活中的4天。白天由士郎的视角讲述，夜晚则由樱成为主角。
